blocks.orig: A night game drive in Lake Manyara National Park gives your safari a completely different twist – animals that hide during the day, now become visible in the headlights of your jeep. Mind you, there are no street lights in a national park, so the lights of your jeep are the only ones you’ll see. Experience the thrill of the night, while your guide tells you all about the porcupines, civet cats, bush babies, hippos, lions and leopards that can be spotted during this time.
blocks.html: Adding a night game drive in Lake Manyara National Park gives your safari an entirely new angle – the animals that stay hidden by day now appear in the headlights of your jeep. Keep in mind that a national park has no street lights, so the only lights you’ll see are those of your own jeep. Feel the excitement of the night while your guide tells you about the porcupines, civet cats, bush babies, hippos, lions and leopards you may spot at this hour.
